verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll docs detail full W-2 payroll processing (regular/off-cycle, multi-location, tax filing) and a distinct contractor payment API supporting direct deposit, check, and historical payments, all within the same platform/API surface, indicating both worker types can be paid from one system. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of running a single combined payroll run covering both W-2 and 1099 workers simultaneously, and clearer documentation on contractor-only account limitations noted in community feedback.
